But I always tell young people, do what your scholars are doing right now and that it takes some time to develop the qualities of heart and mind that will mint you into the leaders that America needs. take time to read, to study, to reflect. There's a great verse in the Bible that speaks about when the Nazarene was growing up. It says, he grew in wisdom and in stature, in grace before God and in grace before men. I think that's a great list for young people to think about, to grow in wisdom, to become people of physical fitness and strength, to open your heart to faith in your life, and build relationships and understand what it is to be a good friend. I think developing all of those qualities for me is the most important thing for a young person at this time in their life. People follow people they trust. And so to become a person that understands the great foundations of our country, can express them as the discipline and the consistency and the grace and the faith to be able to act that out, there's no better way for a young person to prepare for a life of service in the greatest nation on earth.
